title: Your Ball's on My Side
subject: a man on a public tennis court whose neighbour on the next court keeps hitting her balls over the net divider every Saturday morning
caption: Funk-soul R&B in the live-band style of mid-2020s Black American R&B. Live drums with ghost notes on the snare and a loose swung hi-hat; a rubbery fingerstyle bass walking under every bar; a wah-pedal rhythm guitar scratching sixteenths; a Rhodes electric piano playing ninth chords; a short horn section stabbing at the end of each chorus line. Warm live-room recording, dry drums, bass forward, light tape saturation. Male tenor, relaxed and playful in the verses, easing into falsetto and small ad-lib runs in the chorus. 98 BPM, E minor. Flirty, loose and self-amused. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no 808 bass, no EDM synths, no rap verse.
lyrics:
[Intro - wah guitar and bass]

[Verse 1]
Court number four, Saturday, nine on the dot
Her serve's got nowhere to go but into my spot
Yellow ball rolls past my shoe, she's waving her racket
I jog it back slower than anyone has to

[Pre-Chorus]
My buddy says, man, we're meant to be playing

[Chorus]
Your ball's on my side again, don't you worry
I'll bring it back over, I'm in no hurry
Hit it as wild as you want, I'll be waiting
Your ball's on my side again, keep it coming

[Verse 2]
Week number six and she's barely even aiming
Lobs it clean over and points at me, blaming
I said, you're a menace, she said, you're slow
Then she asked for a match, said, winner picks where we go

[Pre-Chorus]
My buddy packs his bag and says, I'm out of here

[Chorus]
Your ball's on my side again, come and get it
Bring your own racket, we'll play one set of it
Loser buys coffee, and I plan on losing
Your ball's on my side again, and so are you

[Outro - horns and Rhodes]
Love fifteen, love thirty
Somebody's gotta keep score
